correctness.rationale: Every cell has eight distinct neighbors; its live-neighbor count is s_j−x_{r,j}, where s_j is the total of the three adjacent columns. Checking the precise B3678/S34678 birth/survival table proves full inversion iff every s_j∈{3,6}, including all-zero/all-one columns. The sixteen pair-column-weight states with T_(a,b),(b,c)=binom(3,b)1_{a+b+c∈{3,6}} enumerate all labelled cycles via trace(T^n). Independently rebuilt this weighted matrix, all n=1..16 traces, and all 16 Newton identities: characteristic polynomial t^4(t−3)^2(t³−18)^2(t²−t−1)(t²+t+1), implying the all-n Lucas/root-of-unity formula. Independently enumerated weighted column words for n=3..8. Complement equivariance yields F²(x)=x and no binary state equals its complement; hence exact least period 2. Dominant classes each have 3^n possibilities; all remaining eigenvalues grow at most 18^(1/3)<3.
